description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zidane], [Grand Lethal Extreme Ability Tracker] and [Grand Lethal Extreme Level]

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zidane
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Grand Lethal Extreme (0~2), removed after using Grand Lethal Extreme two times

description.name: Grand Lethal Extreme Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Grand Lethal Extreme level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Wind abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zidane]

description.name: Grand Lethal Extreme Level
description.text: Keeps track of Grand Lethal Extreme level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Zidane]
